title: JC said Navy running Majestic 12 was right
summary: Bryce Zable tells of JC said Navy running Majestic 12 was right, about 1996 at Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: things he said we got right is we had the the guy running Majestic 12 be from the Navy.

plain: Bryce Zable, speaking on a podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, says that in 1996 in Los Angeles a man he calls JC told him what his team's fictional work got right. One thing, Zable says, was making the man in charge of Majestic 12, a claimed secret group said to handle UFO matters, an officer from the Navy. If true, it would mean the fiction came close to a real secret.
